steps.what: Open the stops for this establishment
Deliver messages, newspapers, documents, and packages
Carry items between establishment departments, other establishments, and private homes

tasks.design: Stops are opened from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier delivers messages and items, such as newspapers, documents, and packages, between establishment departments, to other establishments, and to private homes. The list does not carry the items.
tasks.previous_blocker: The round was a stack of notes in department order.
tasks.enabler_now: The stops are already in order on the run.
tasks.still_hard: Carrying and handing over stay with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier handles the item and finds the person.
tasks.altitude: The round does not change. The stop order is only written down once.

evidence.claim: A stored stop list can name departments and addresses. Carrying the items stays with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a round starts and ends when the items are handed over or brought back.
A stop row has stop id, place, and item id, entered by the dispatcher.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often a department or a home is not the place on the stop.
research_questions: Which stops were delivered, and which items came back?

already_counted.description: The trip or the note is already in the courier's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened stop when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many places are not as listed. High: the stops are listed and the courier still carries and hands over. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Record information and recipients' responses to messages

tasks.design: Items received and delivered are opened from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier records the information and the recipients' responses to messages. A response the courier did not hear is not stored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The courier copied item ids into a day book and wrote the reply beside them.
tasks.enabler_now: The item ids are already on the run.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing the response and writing it stay with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier heard what was said.

ambition.what: The item list is open when the courier writes the response, and the courier still writes it.

tasks.altitude: The courier writes the response. The list does not.

reach.learn: Which item the note is about.

evidence.claim: Item ids already on a run can be opened. The response text stays with the courier who heard it. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when an item is received or delivered and ends when the courier has recorded the response or noted that there was none.
An item row has item id and status. The response is text the courier typed. An empty response is allowed and is not invented.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often there is no response to record.
research_questions: Which items have a response, and which have none?

incremental.description: Update the opened stop when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: item ids were never on the run, so the courier writes them too. High: the ids are listed and the courier only writes the response. The range stays under the net.

tasks.short: Unload items collected on the route

steps.what: Show the delivery routes for collected items
Unload items collected along the delivery routes

tasks.design: The delivery route for the collected items is shown from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier unloads and sorts the items collected along the route. The screen does not unload the vehicle.
tasks.previous_blocker: The route order was a mental list.
tasks.still_hard: Unloading and sorting by hand stay with the courier.

evidence.claim: A stored route can be shown. Unloading stays with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when the courier returns with collected items and ends when the items are unloaded.
A route row has route id and stop ids, entered before the run.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often collected items are not on the route.
research_questions: Which items matched the route, and which did not?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many items are not on the route. High: the route is shown and the unloading remains. The range stays under the net.

steps.what: Open the delivery route for this run
Sort items to be delivered according to the delivery route

tasks.design: The delivery route is opened from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier sorts the items to be delivered according to that route. The route does not sort the items.
tasks.previous_blocker: The courier re-read addresses and sorted from memory.
tasks.still_hard: Handling and ordering the physical items stay with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier sees the item and the address.
tasks.altitude: The sorting by hand stays. The route order is the reference.

reach.learn: Which route they were sorted to.

evidence.claim: A stored route order can be shown. Sorting the items stays with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when items are ready to go out and ends when they are sorted or set aside.
A route row has an ordered list of stop ids. An item with no stop is set aside.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.

The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often an item has no stop on the route.
research_questions: Which items were sorted to the route, and which were set aside?
